issue.title: [ecnconfig] Exception while displaying ecn status on queue

failure.body:
#### Description

admin@sonic:~$ ecnconfig -q 3
Exception caught:  'dict_keys' object has no attribute 'sort'

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Issue the command mentioned above and the error should be seen

#### Describe the results you received:
Exception caught:  'dict_keys' object has no attribute 'sort'

#### Describe the results you expected:
admin@sonic:~$ ecnconfig -q 3
ECN status:
queue 3: on

resolution.title: [ecnconfig] Fix exception seen during display and add unit tests
resolution.description:
Fixes Azure/sonic-buildimage#8323 and added unit tests for all ecn queue configs. This regression was caused because the current ecn unit tests didn't cover the queue configs.

#### How to verify it
Ran tests/ecn_test.py and all cases passed
